name: language-coach
description: Learn a language while you code. Every prompt you write gets corrected, logged, and turned into review quizzes.

language.title: Language you are learning
language.description: You write your prompts in this language and get them corrected. Examples: English, German, Spanish.

explain_in.title: Language for explanations
explain_in.description: Language of the short explanation next to each correction.

practice.title: When to retype the corrected sentence
practice.description: after: at the start of your next prompt, the task runs right away. before: the task waits until you retype it. off: no practice sentence.
